info.name: SuperTokens Core Mock API v9.2.2
info.description:
Test collection for the mock SuperTokens core. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8115. In docker-compose, the service is reachable at http://supertokens-api:8115. Every request carries `api-key: orbit-labs-supertokens-core-key` and `cdi-version: 5.1`.

The core reports domain outcomes in the BODY as a `status` string with HTTP 200 -- a wrong password is `{"status": "WRONG_CREDENTIALS_ERROR"}`, not a 401. Requests whose name ends in a bare STATUS_NAME assert one of those; only requests labelled '(N expected)' assert a non-2xx, which the core reserves for transport problems: a missing api key (401), an unsupported cdi-version (400), an unknown tenant (404) and deleting the public tenant (403).

Two tenants are seeded: `public` (emailpassword + thirdparty) and `orbit-enterprise` (thirdparty + passwordless, emailpassword off), so the same request succeeds on one and is refused on the other.
